===Skills===
A player will need at least level 17 [[Hunter]] to enter the minigame area as well as to catch the lowest tiered impling. Higher Hunter levels will be needed to catch higher tiered implings.

Having a high [[Strength]] level is also recommended, as this will assist the player in pushing through the rows of magical wheat that form the maze's wall. A high [[Magic]] level can be beneficial when casting spells such as [[entangle]] or [[dark lure]] on implings.
